new.subject: UniProtKB:P77243
new.description: This records the physiological cis-product branch, not universal stereoisomer acceptance. Native curation preserves disagreement over whether PrpD contains an iron-sulfur cluster; one primary study reports an unstable [2Fe-2S] cluster in its preparation. No obligatory cofactor or cofactor-independence edge is asserted.

evidence.source_assertion: FUNCTION assigns dehydration of methylcitrate to cis-methylaconitate (ECO:0000269; PMID:11782506 and PMID:12473114); SUBUNIT states monomer. CAUTION retains the substrate stereochemistry conflict.
The abstract reports that E. coli PrpD can dehydrate at least two methylcitrate stereoisomers; the physiological pathways proceed through (Z)-2-methylaconitate.
Approved generic dehydration 57497 belongs to master 57496, which cites PMID:28956599 and is the parent of specific master 17725.

The native comment preserves disagreement between PMID:11782506 and PMID:12473114 over whether PrpD contains an iron-sulfur cluster. This is a curated conflict statement, not a resolution of the metal requirement.

The primary abstract reports one unstable [2Fe-2S] cluster per purified PrpD monomer, needed for maximum catalytic activity in that preparation and reconstitutable with Fe(2+) under reducing conditions.

scientific_assessment: The precise native conflict and primary unstable-cluster assertions are supported by their added local evidence. The conflict remains biologically unresolved, and no obligatory cofactor or metal independence is asserted. All nodes, chemical sides, directions and other edges are unchanged.
issue332_assessment: Independent initial original-RDF and primary supplement review supports the separately issued generic reaction representation; the absolute stereochemistry question remains unresolved. This correction does not change that assessment.
source_manifest_continuity: All 39 original body paths and declared hashes are identical to the independently rehashed initial source set. Both newly cited originals were independently rehashed again for the correction. All 29 final reference digests resolve to that source set.
